Hi Anya,

Thanks again for the productive discussion last week. Attached is a first-pass draft of the case study we discussed (brightlayer-draft-case-study-v1.pdf). Would you mind reviewing and confirming whether BrightLayer is comfortable with Redwood publishing this publicly and, if so, what publication timing you'd prefer?

- Any parts you want redacted or changed (customer metrics, quotes)?

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for sending the draft. The content looks good overall, but I need to flag a timing concern. We had a production incident on Aug 9 that affected a handful of customers (we're still running our post-incident review this week). A public case study right now could be misinterpreted by customers or the press - it might look like we're touting success immediately after an outage.

Legal asked that we delay any public materials until the incident RCA and customer outreach are complete. I've attached a short incident summary (incident_summary-BL-20260809.pdf) so you have context. We're targeting to finish our internal review by Aug 16, after which I'll be able to give a definitive go/no-go.

Can Redwood hold off on publishing until I confirm? Also, please coordinate with your marketing and legal teams if you need approvals or wording changes.

Best,
Anya
VP Customer Operations
BrightLayer Inc

Attachment: incident_summary-BL-20260809.pdf
